paper_info.title: MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices
paper_info.abstract_summary: Introduces MobileIE, an extremely lightweight CNN framework with around 4K parameters for real-time image enhancement on mobile devices, integrating re-parameterization, Incremental Weight Optimization, Feature Self-Transform module, Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention mechanism, and Local Variance-Weighted loss to achieve high speed and competitive image quality.

model_architecture.overall_description: MobileIE employs a streamlined topology with deployable operators, decoupling training and inference phases. It uses MBRConv for multi-scale feature capture, FST for nonlinear feature interactions, and HDPA for fusing global and local features, re-parameterizing into standard convolution during inference.

components.name: MBRConv
components.input_output: Captures multi-scale features, processed through concatenation, compression, and mapping to output dimensions
components.remarks: Re-parameterizes into standard convolution during inference

components.name: FST
components.layers_or_blocks: Captures nonlinear relationships through secondary feature interactions

components.name: HDPA
components.remarks: Hardware-friendly, enhances focus on critical regions

special_mechanisms.name: Incremental Weight Optimization (IWO) Strategy
special_mechanisms.description: Freezes prior knowledge, integrates it into trainable convolutional kernels, and re-parameterizes these into new kernels to boost model performance

special_mechanisms.name: Re-parameterization
special_mechanisms.description: Used in MBRConv to convert multi-branch convolutions into standard convolution during inference, reducing model size

notes_on_training_behavior: IWO strategy addresses training bottlenecks by freezing prior knowledge and re-parameterizing kernels; LVW Loss enhances accuracy without increasing parameters.

reproducibility_related_info.code_structure_described: Detailed architecture settings provided in the Appendix
